item.title: EplayerX 1.2.32
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改进剧集与播放资源的对应关系，让选集、续播和跳转最新可播放剧集更加准确。 - 统一详情页和继续观看中的播放工具，改善切换资源与字幕的操作体验。 - 优化字幕设置面板的布局与说明，统一字幕外观偏好，同时保留当前内容的独立播放调整。 - 改善预告片的加载与超时处理，减少无响应的等待。 - 优化社区内容加载，改善 AI 字幕的识别与状态恢复。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved episode-to-resource matching for more accurate episode selection, resume playback, and navigation to the latest playable episode. - Unified playback tools on detail pages and Continue Watching for smoother resource and subtitle switching. - Refined the subtitle settings layout and guidance, with consistent appearance preferences and separate playback adjustments for the current title. - Improved trailer loading and timeout handling to reduce unresponsive waits. - Improved community content loading, AI subtitle recognition, and subtitle state restoration.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
